A little clarity

Questions before bed?

Everything you need to know before Wave becomes part of your evening.

Does Wave of Dreams contain caffeine?

No. Wave of Dreams is caffeine-free, so it is designed to fit into your wind-down rather than interrupt it.

When should I drink it?

We like it chilled, around 30 minutes before you plan to sleep. The best ritual is the one you can repeat, so choose a time that works for you.

Can I pause my subscription?

Yes. You can pause, skip or cancel whenever you need a break. Subscription deliveries are scheduled every four weeks.

Is it vegan and low in sugar?

Yes. The recipe is vegan and lightly sweetened, with no artificial colours. Always check the can if you have a specific allergy or dietary requirement.

Will it make me fall asleep?

Wave is a soft drink for your evening ritual, not a medicine or sleep aid. It is made to support a calmer routine, and everybody's sleep experience is different.
